 CIO Greatest Hits: Single Family Offices – Dawn Fitzpatrick (Soros) Jul 28, 2025

 This week’s Summer Series is another twofer,
Dawn Fitzpatrick from Soros and Steve Rattner from Willett
Advisors, Michael Bloomberg’s family office. We packaged these two
leading single-family offices together to hear their different
approaches to a similar investment challenge, with Soros leaning
heavily on internal teams and Willett primarily on external.

 Please enjoy my conversations with Dawn
Fitzpatrick and Steve Rattner, both from 2019.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
